primary_metric: number of build scenarios with both a native-success and native-failure episode whose recorded prefixes replay identically
falsification: Zero mixed-outcome scenarios rejects sufficiency of this source protocol; any native success alone is not contract efficacy or an admitted bank
selection_note: Same four build scenarios and first variants, two replicates, model/provider, seed schedule, role prompts, output token caps, tools and native evaluator as cycle09. Only preregistered context/horizon and validated runtime changes. Reserved partitions remain unopened; oracle scenario excluded.
interpretation: Bundled common-workflow resource/presentation diagnostic, not a checkpoint-locked causal estimate, equal-compute comparison, native published-baseline reproduction, or learned-memory gain. Record all outcomes, failures and costs; no outcome-dependent substitution.
